comment: Shared PDO link and heartbeat watch fixtures (canopen-pdo-links), in the same form as cases.json and run by the
same tests in the plugin (test/unit) and the deploy tool (tools/deploy/tests). Node 10 (stick) produces TPDO 1,
node 20 (valves) consumes it on RPDO 2 and watches node 10's heartbeat; node 21 (fixed) has a fixed mapping and
read-only COB-IDs (fixed-io.eds). EDS files: link-io.eds and link-io-small.eds (make_link_eds.py).

cases.name: link with a dummy entry and a heartbeat watch
link without a name
no links: the producer entry without a location
messages: (only an entry a gateway route or a PDO link uses may leave it out)

cases.name: producer TPDO not configured
messages: link stick_to_valves: node 10 (stick) has no TPDO 3 in its tx_pdos (a link's 'from' names one of the producer's tx_pdos)

cases.name: producer not a node
messages: link stick_to_valves: node 30 is not a configured node of this network

cases.name: consumer not a node
messages: link stick_to_valves: consumer node 30 is not a configured node of this network

cases.name: consumer is the producer
messages: link stick_to_valves: node 10 (stick) is the producer; a consumer must be another node

cases.name: consumer RPDO also in rx_pdos
messages: link stick_to_valves: node 20 (valves) RPDO 2 is also in its rx_pdos; a link's consumer RPDO is fed by the producer, not the master

cases.name: two links from one TPDO
messages: link stick_to_valves and link 2 both name node 10 (stick) TPDO 1 in 'from'; list all consumers in one link

cases.name: one consumer RPDO in two links
messages: link 2: node 20 (valves) RPDO 2 is already a consumer of link stick_to_valves

cases.name: consumer entry with a location
messages: field 'iec_location' (links[0].to[0].entries[0].iec_location) does not belong to a link consumer's entry

cases.name: layout length mismatch
messages: link stick_to_valves: node 20 (valves) RPDO 2 maps 16 bits in 1 position, but node 10 (stick) TPDO 1 sends 32 bits in 2 positions

cases.name: different type at the same size
warnings: link stick_to_valves: position 1: node 10 (stick) TPDO 1 sends 0x6401:1 as INTEGER16 and node 20 (valves) RPDO 2 receives it in 0x2000:0 as UNSIGNED16; the bits are copied unchanged

cases.name: read-only consumer object
messages: link stick_to_valves: node 20, index 0x2002, subindex 0: a link consumer entry needs an object the node can receive (AccessType wo, rw or rww), but its AccessType is ro

cases.name: consumer object of another type
messages: link stick_to_valves: node 20, index 0x6411, subindex 1: configured type UNSIGNED16 does not match the EDS data type INTEGER16

cases.name: dummy entry the consumer does not allow
messages: link stick_to_valves: node 20 (valves) RPDO 2 entries[1]: dummy entry 0x0001 needs Dummy0001=1 in [DummyUsage] of link-io.eds

cases.name: dummy entry of the wrong type
messages: link stick_to_valves: node 20 (valves) RPDO 2 entries[1]: dummy entry 0x0003 is INTEGER16, not UNSIGNED16

cases.name: consumer RPDO not in the EDS
messages: link stick_to_valves: node 20 (valves) RPDO 5 does not exist in link-io.eds (no object 0x1404/0x1604)

cases.name: fixed consumer: COB-ID and default mapping
messages: link stick_to_valves: node 21 (fixed) RPDO 1 can only receive 0x215 (fixed-io.eds makes 0x1400 subindex 1 ro); the producer node 10 (stick) TPDO 1 needs "cob_id": "0x215"

link stick_to_valves: node 21 (fixed) RPDO 1 uses the default mapping from fixed-io.eds (0x6200:1 (8 bit), 0x6200:2 (8 bit)), which does not match node 10 (stick) TPDO 1 (0x6401:1 (16 bit), 0x6401:2 (16 bit))

cases.name: fixed consumer with the config's mapping
messages: link stick_to_valves: node 21 (fixed) RPDO 1: 'mapping' is "config", but fixed-io.eds fixes the mapping (0x1600 subindex 0 is ro)

cases.name: COB-ID clash with the link
messages: node 20 (valves) TPDO 1 and node 10 (stick) TPDO 1 (link stick_to_valves) both use COB-ID 0x18A

cases.name: synchronous consumer without SYNC
messages: link stick_to_valves: node 20 (valves) RPDO 2: transmission type 1 needs SYNC, but the master produces none

cases.name: event-driven link without SYNC
kept link with a synchronous producer
warnings: link stick_to_valves: "on_plc_stop": "keep", but node 10 (stick) TPDO 1 is synchronous (transmission type 1): the link stops when the PLC stops because SYNC stops

cases.name: kept link with a node watching the master
warnings: link stick_to_valves: "on_plc_stop": "keep", but node 20 (valves) watches the master's heartbeat (heartbeat_consumer), which stops when the PLC stops

cases.name: link on_plc_stop unknown
plugin_messages: link stick_to_valves: field 'on_plc_stop' must be "follow" or "keep"

cases.name: consumer without entries or device mapping
plugin_messages: missing required field 'entries' (a non-empty array), or "mapping": "device"

cases.name: heartbeat watch of a guarded node
messages: node 20 (valves): heartbeat_watch[0]: node 10 (stick) sends no heartbeat (it uses node guarding); a heartbeat watch needs the watched node's heartbeat

cases.name: heartbeat watch of itself
messages: node 20 (valves): heartbeat_watch[0]: a node cannot watch its own heartbeat

cases.name: heartbeat watch of the master
messages: node 20 (valves): heartbeat_watch[0]: node 1 is the master; use 'heartbeat_consumer' to watch the master's heartbeat

cases.name: heartbeat watch of an unknown node
messages: node 20 (valves): heartbeat_watch[0]: node 30 is not a configured node of this network

cases.name: heartbeat watch timeout not above the period
messages: node 20 (valves): heartbeat_watch[0]: timeout_ms 100 must be above node 10 (stick)'s heartbeat period of 100 ms

cases.name: heartbeat watch with its own timeout
heartbeat watch next to the master's entry
heartbeat watch without room in 0x1016
messages: node 20 (valves): heartbeat_watch: 0x1016 in link-io-small.eds has room for 1 entry where 2 are needed (1 for the master's heartbeat, 1 for heartbeat_watch)

cases.name: heartbeat watch of a node without 0x1016
messages: node 21 (fixed): heartbeat_watch needs object 0x1016 (consumer heartbeat time), which fixed-io.eds does not define

cases.name: startup SDO overrides the heartbeat watch
warnings: startup SDO to 0x1016 subindex 1 runs last and overrides heartbeat_watch

cases.name: startup SDO to the consumer RPDO
warnings: startup SDO to 0x1601 subindex 0 runs last and overrides the consumer RPDO of a PDO link ('links')
